rows.label: Archon's Protection
rows.value: Reaction - Trigger An enemy damages the archon's ally and both are within 15 feet of the archon - Effect The ally gains resistance 3 to all damage against the triggering damage and the archon can make a Strike against the enemy.

rows.label: Ranged
rows.value: Single Action eye ray +8 ( Agile, Fire, Holy, Magical, range 30 feet ); Damage 1d8 fire

rows.label: Spells
rows.value: DC 17 - Cantrips (1st) Light - 1st Heal - 4th Read Omens

rows.label: Behold!
rows.value: Two Actions ( Concentrate, Illusion, Incapacitation, Visual ) Frequency once per hour - Effect The zoaem's rings and wings move in a complex pattern, mesmerizing creatures in the zoaem's choice of a 10-foot emanation or a 5-foot burst within 60 feet. Each creature must succeed at a DC 17 Will save or be fascinated with the zoaem for 1 minute and stunned 1 (or stunned for 1 round on a critical failure).

rows.label: Light of Truth
rows.value: Single Action ( Concentrate, Divine, Light ) The zoaem shines an intense light of truth, as _revealing light_ but in a 60-foot line. Against creatures affected by this light, the zoaem and their allies gain a +1 status bonus to damage rolls and Recall Knowledge checks. The zoaem can't use Light of Truth again for 1d4 rounds.
